name: policy-refund
objective: Draft a reply to a customer requesting a refund for a purchase made 20 days ago with a receipt. Company policy: refunds are granted within 30 days of purchase WITH a receipt, no exceptions either way.
output_contract: A short reply that applies the stated policy correctly to this case.

candidates.A: Thank you for reaching out. As a gesture of goodwill we refund all purchases regardless of receipt or date, so your refund is on its way.
candidates.B: Thank you for reaching out. Your purchase was 20 days ago and you have a receipt, so it falls within our 30-day refund window — we will process your refund.
candidates.C: Thank you for reaching out. Unfortunately we cannot refund any purchases once completed; we can offer store credit instead.
